|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Nick Of Time (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on table. Dack and Wes each gain[Pilot] 2. Once during your control phase, you may ▲ any vehicle weapon, Attack Pattern Delta, Desperate Tactics, Lucky Shot, One More Pass, or Rapid Fire. You may lose 2 Force to cancel Trample or Walker Barrage. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on table. Dack Ralter and Wes Janson have Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During your control phase, may take one Attack Pattern Delta, Desperate Tactics, Lucky Shot, One More Pass, Rapid Fire, or a vehicle weapon into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May lose 2 Force to cancel Trample or Walker Barrage. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' added “Ralter”; “each gain[Pilot] 2. Once during” → “Janson have Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During”; removed “you”; “▲ any vehicle weapon,” → “take one”; added “Rapid Fire,”; “Rapid Fire. You may” → “a vehicle weapon into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May”; “[Immune” → “(Immune”; “Alter]” → “Alter.)”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153629/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards4.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 2, slip 14. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Nick Of Time]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth#Cards|Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Nick Of Time (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Nick Of Time]]. Code OVS4 · GEMP id 1104_14.
